column1: # Applied symbol names for pulse-psp-eu BOOT.BIN (image base 0x08804000).
# Unlike psp-pulse-usa's names.tsv, every row here is a name carried over from
# the USA binary via cross-binary fuzzy matching, not an independent
# derivation - see corroboration.md for the method and the per-function diff
# against its USA counterpart. Confidence is capped accordingly.
# There is no `just` recipe for this set yet; run the script directly, with
# the program name and this file both given explicitly, against a bridge that
# kind is `function` or `data`. Confidence below 70 gets a `_q` suffix
# Full sweep (2026-08-05): every function psp-pulse-usa/names.tsv documents,
# checked against this binary with find_similar_functions_fuzzy at threshold
# 0.95 and verified individually with diff_functions before renaming. See
# corroboration.md for what did NOT survive verification (collision-prone
# targets, ambiguous multi-way matches) and was deliberately left out.
# full 304-row set checked against this binary with bulk_fuzzy_match at
# threshold 0.8 (conservative 0.95 dropped genuine matches on this pair,
# since psp-pulse-eu and psp-pulse-usa are the same build region-shifted -
# only literal pools and relocated data move). Every row verified
# individually with diff_functions before renaming. See corroboration.md for
# the drift issue this pass found in psp-pulse-usa's live database, the
# collision-check method, and why the confidences below trend lower than the
# USA source (weaker fuzzy score / body-equal ratio, not weaker logic match).
